messages:
sophie: quick RFC follow-up on pool preemption: proposing a tiny 'preempt_hint' token so operators can make fast latency-aware evict decisions without heavy control-plane calls. text below.

anya: sounds promising. what fields do you need in the token?

sophie: minimal: model_family, warmup_ms, p95_inflation_pct, conf, expires. e.g. {mf:llama-2-13b, wm:120, p95:18, conf:0.72, exp:1768130120}. signed by control plane.

matt: where do probes run? we shouldn't run synthetic probes on shared GPUs.

sophie: probes run in sandboxed CPU containers or tiny dedicated slices. payloads are synthetic, deterministic, no tenant data. probe budget is per-pool and per-model-family.

raj: operator fallback if control-plane unreachable?

sophie: operator rules: (1) if no valid hint -> conservative_preempt_window (default 400ms), (2) if pool util > 92% for >90s -> emergency bypass, (3) if hint present -> apply hint score but clamp by tenant max_override.

anya: probes are noisy. include conf and require conf>=0.6 to emit token. also smooth across tenants to avoid manipulation.

sophie: agreed. token emission requires min_samples and conf threshold. influence is capped per-tenant.

matt: rollout plan?

sophie: simulate with replay first (14d), then staging opt-in (metrics only), then soft-enforce (evictions allowed but flagged), then global. expose metrics: hint_emitted, hint_age, probe_rps, blocked_evictions, emergency_bypasses.

raj: add a merged_hint behaviour: operator merges multiple model-family hints to prevent thrash (weighted by recency/conf).

sophie: will add pseudocode. also adding signed tiny tokens to keep operator fast-path cheap.

infra-bot: policy-controller v0.53.2 scheduled to staging with probe-sandbox flag ON (triggered by sophie).

anya: ok please update the RFC with token schema, probe sandboxing, smoothing rules, rollout checklist. i'll review sim results.

sophie: will update by EOD and attach a sample replay. thanks!
